scripts.check: vp check && vp build && pnpm frontiere && pnpm taille && vp test run
scripts.frontiere: ! grep -rnE "from ['\"](\\.\\./)+app/" src/core/ && ! grep -rnE "FILTRE_ACCES|filtreAcces|parametresAcces|statut = 'certifiee'|legende_statut = 'certified'|school_id =|membres_cours|role = '" src/app/routes/ && ! grep -rnE "from ['\"]\\.\\.?/(vues|routes)/" src/app --exclude-dir=routes --exclude-dir=vues --exclude=routes.ts && ! grep -rnE "from ['\"]\\.\\./routes/|\\.prepare\\(" src/app/vues/
scripts.taille: ! find src tests -name '*.ts' | xargs wc -l | awk '$2 != "total" && $1 > ($2 ~ /^src\// ? 600 : 800)' | grep .
